preconditions.expression: t == int(stdin.split()[0]) and t > 0 and t <= 30
preconditions.description: The first line of input is a positive integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 30) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all('\n'.join(line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[i+1:i+2*m+1]).split() for i in range(0, len(stdin.splitlines()), 2*m+1))
preconditions.description: Each test case starts with two integers n and m (1 ≤ n ≤ 100, 1 ≤ m ≤ 30), followed by m lines describing subsets S1, ..., Sm of X = {0, ..., n-1}. Each subset line starts with vi (1 ≤ vi ≤ n) followed by vi distinct integers in [0, n-1].

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(x) < n for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for x in line.split()[1:])
preconditions.description: All elements in subsets Si are integers in the range [0, n-1].

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(line.split()[1:])) == int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each subset Si has exactly vi distinct elements.

preconditions.expression: all(any(int(x) in set(line.split()[1:]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[i+1:i+2*m+1]) for i in range(0, len(stdin.splitlines()), 2*m+1) for x in range(n))
preconditions.description: Every integer in X = {0, ..., n-1} appears in at least one subset Si for each test case.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip().split() == ['\n'.join(str(min_atoms) for min_atoms in [compute_min_atoms(test_case) for test_case in parse_test_cases(stdin)])]
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is a single integer representing the minimum number of atoms k such that X is partitioned into atoms A1, ..., Ak where each atom Ai is either a subset of some Si or disjoint from every Si.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(output_line) <= n for output_line in stdout.strip().split())
postconditions.description: The output for each test case is a positive integer k (1 ≤ k ≤ n), as the trivial partition into singletons always exists.

postconditions.expression: all(atom_partition_exists(test_case, int(output_line)) for test_case, output_line in zip(parse_test_cases(stdin), stdout.strip().split()))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output k is achievable: there exists a partition of X into k atoms satisfying the subset/disjointness condition for all Si.

postconditions.expression: all(not exists_smaller_k(test_case, int(output_line)) for test_case, output_line in zip(parse_test_cases(stdin), stdout.strip().split()))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output k is minimal: no partition into fewer than k atoms satisfies the subset/disjointness condition for all Si.
